description: This bar chart, titled "Quality Scores," illustrates the comparison of three distinct metrics—labeled "Base AvgSub," "AvgQty," and "AvgSub"—across three different evaluation categories: "IFD," "TagNum," and "DEITA." The vertical axis, labeled "Scores," is scaled linearly from 30 to 70, with major tick marks at intervals of 5. The horizontal axis presents the three evaluation categories in order from left to right. For each category, two bars are displayed: a taller, light blue bar representing "AvgQty" and a shorter, salmon-colored bar representing "AvgSub." The "AvgQty" scores are 63.98 for IFD, 66.06 for TagNum, and 67.64 for DEITA. The corresponding "AvgSub" scores are 41.90 for IFD, 39.13 for TagNum, and 42.99 for DEITA. The chart also features two horizontal reference lines: a dashed blue line at the level of 64.71 (which appears to be the value for "AvgQty" at DEITA) and a dashed orange line at 39.13 (which matches the "AvgSub" score for TagNum). A legend in the upper right corner identifies the light blue bar as "AvgQty," the salmon-colored bar as "AvgSub," the dashed blue line as "Base AvgSub," and the dashed orange line as "AvgQty." The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and labeling.
